notes: Curated eval focused on internal account decision support rather than external executive briefings.

should_trigger.prompt: Prepare an internal account brief for our top expansion target in EMEA. I need stakeholder mapping, upside and risk, a near-term action plan aligned to the decision window, and freshness notes because our CRM and Gong records are inconsistent.
Build a concise account brief for a weekly deal strategy review. Include commercial state, blockers, champion strength, procurement risk, and the specific decisions we need to make this week.
Summarize this account into one decision-ready internal brief using CRM history, recent calls, and internal notes. Flag stale data explicitly and do not fabricate missing facts.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Create an executive-facing briefing memo for our CEO before tomorrow's customer meeting.
Build a QBR structure for a strategic customer renewal conversation.
Draft a mutual action plan with owners, dates, and buyer-visible milestones.

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Executive summary (5-8 lines)

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Stakeholder map with influence/stance

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Risk register with trigger and mitigation

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: A near-term action plan aligned to the decision window, with owners and verified or proposed dates

output_structure_checks.name: account-brief-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: The output substantively includes: Data freshness and source-priority notes
